## CheatReader v0.1.32

### Fixes
- Fixed the text selection setting not staying enabled on Windows after clicking the switch (#26).
- Fixed English words being clipped at the end of a visual line instead of continuing on the next line (#25).

### Notes
- Text selection is disabled by default to preserve the existing window-drag interaction. Enable it in Reading Settings when you need to select and copy text for translation.
- Existing reader settings, bookshelf data, and reading progress continue to work as before.

### Verification
- Added coverage for the persisted text selection preference and ran the full Flutter test suite.
- `flutter analyze` passes with no issues.
